deleteAccount.blockersTitle: You'll need to sort a few things out first
deleteAccount.permanentBody: Deleting your account removes your name, photo, and login from NanbaGO right away — you won't be able to sign in with this number again. Past trip records tied to other users are kept, but without anything that identifies them as yours.
deleteAccount.confirmBody: This can't be undone. Your name, photo, and login are removed permanently, and you won't be able to sign in with this number again.
loginPasscode.title: Login passcode
loginPasscode.description: Download a 6-digit passcode once, and use it to log in on any device instead of requesting a fresh OTP every time.
loginPasscode.warning: Unlike an OTP, this code doesn't expire on its own — treat the downloaded file like a password. Anyone who has it can log in as you.
loginPasscode.activeStatus: A passcode is active on this account.
loginPasscode.regenerateHint: Generating a new one immediately cancels the old file.

chatDetail.title: Chat
chatDetail.infoBody:
This conversation is only for coordinating pickup. It's automatically cleared once your trip starts (or the booking is cancelled), so don't rely on it to look something up later.

For your safety, never share OTPs, passwords, banking details, or other sensitive personal information here.

locationPermission.description: We use your location during an active trip so the other rider can track progress and to power the SOS button if you ever need help. Location isn't tracked outside of active trips.
locationSearch.micPermissionDenied: Microphone access is needed for voice search.
locationSearch.micPermissionDescription: We use your microphone only while you're speaking a location, to turn it into a search — nothing is recorded or stored.

history.cancelPolicyAvailable: You can cancel this ride for free as long as no passenger has paid the platform fee yet. Once someone pays and their seat is confirmed, the ride can no longer be cancelled outright — you'd need to edit it instead, or remove that passenger individually. Cancelling isn't possible once a trip is already in progress.
history.cancelPolicyBlocked: A passenger has already paid the platform fee and locked in their seat, so this ride can't be cancelled outright anymore. You can still edit the ride's seats, price, or time, or remove that specific passenger if needed. Cancelling isn't possible once a trip is already in progress.
verification.title: Get verified
verification.licenseFailed: We couldn't verify your license. Double-check the details and try again.
verification.driverFeeHint: A small one-time fee to check your driving license.
verification.enterLicenseDetailsBody: Add your driving license number and date of birth to continue.
verification.vehicleFeeHint: A small fee to check this vehicle's RC — every vehicle needs its own.
verification.whyBody: Passengers see a green "Verified" badge on your rides, so they trust you and book faster. Each check is quick — pay a small fee, and we verify your license or RC automatically.
verification.whyBenefit1: More bookings — verified drivers stand out in search
verification.whyBenefit2: Instant passenger trust, no waiting on manual review
verification.whyBenefit3: Small, separate fees — your license, and each vehicle's RC
verification.previewGood: Eko verified this — review the details, then confirm.
verification.previewBad: Eko couldn't verify this against the details entered. Double-check and try again, or confirm to record this result.
verification.pendingReview: You have a check waiting to be reviewed and confirmed.
verification.otpSentHint: We've sent a 6-digit OTP to the mobile number linked with this Aadhaar in UIDAI's records.
